atm.md
## What is my daily ATM withdrawal limit?
The default daily ATM withdrawal limit is S$3,000.

atm.md
## Is there a fee for using overseas ATMs?
Each overseas ATM withdrawal costs S$5, plus the foreign currency fee of 3.25%.

branches.md
## What are your branch opening hours?
Branches are open Monday to Friday from 9:30am to 4:30pm, and Saturday from 9:30am to 12:30pm. Branches are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

branches.md
## How many branches do you have?
Merlion Bank has 12 branches across Singapore.

closing-an-account.md
## How do I close my account?
Visit any branch or send us a secure message in the app.

closing-an-account.md
## Is there a fee to close my account?
An early closure fee of S$30 applies if you close the account within 6 months of opening it.

contact-us.md
## How can I contact Merlion Bank?
Call our hotline on 1800-000-0000, available from 8am to 8pm daily, or 24 hours for lost cards and scams. You can also email support@merlionbank.example.

contact-us.md
## Can I make a complaint?
Yes. Send your complaint through the app or by email and we will reply within 5 working days.

credit-cards.md
## What is the annual fee?
The annual fee is S$196.20 including GST. It is waived for the first year.

credit-cards.md
## What happens if I pay late?
A late payment fee of S$100 applies and interest of 27.8% p.a. is charged on the outstanding balance.

credit-cards.md
## What is the minimum income to apply?
You need an annual income of at least S$30,000.

current-account.md
## Is there a fall-below fee?
A fall-below fee of S$7 per month applies if your average daily balance is below S$3,000.

current-account.md
## How much do I need to open a Current Account?
The minimum initial deposit is S$1,000.

current-account.md
## Do you charge for cheque books?
Your first cheque book is free. Each additional cheque book costs S$20.

debit-card.md
## How much does a replacement debit card cost?
A replacement debit card costs S$5.

debit-card.md
## What is my daily spending limit?
The default daily spending limit is S$5,000. You can lower or raise it in the Merlion Bank app.

debit-card.md
## Can I use my debit card overseas?
Yes. Overseas transactions carry a foreign currency fee of 3.25% of the transaction amount.

fees-and-charges.md
## Do you charge for counter services?
Counter withdrawals and deposits are free. Coin deposits above 500 coins are charged S$2 per 100 coins.

fees-and-charges.md
## Is there a fee for cashier's orders?
Each cashier's order costs S$5.

fees-and-charges.md
## Do you charge for account statements?
E-statements are free. Paper statements cost S$2 per month.

fixed-deposits.md
## What fixed deposit rates do you offer?
The current board rates are 2.60% p.a. for a 6-month tenure and 2.45% p.a. for a 12-month tenure.

fixed-deposits.md
## What is the minimum placement?
The minimum placement is S$1,000.

fixed-deposits.md
## Can I withdraw early?
Yes, but if you withdraw before maturity you will not earn any interest on that placement.

home-loans.md
## What home loan rates do you offer?
Our 2-year fixed rate package is 2.75% p.a.

home-loans.md
## Is there a lock-in period?
The fixed rate package has a lock-in period of 2 years.

home-loans.md
## Is there a prepayment penalty?
Repaying in full during the lock-in period incurs a penalty of 1.5% of the amount repaid.

interest-and-tax.md
## When is interest credited?
Interest on savings and current accounts is credited monthly.

interest-and-tax.md
## Can I get a yearly interest statement?
Yes. You can download a yearly interest statement from the app free of charge.

local-transfers.md
## Do local transfers cost anything?
Local transfers and PayNow transfers are free.

local-transfers.md
## What is the daily transfer limit?
The default daily limit is S$5,000. You can raise it to a maximum of S$200,000 in the app.

local-transfers.md
## How fast are local transfers?
PayNow and FAST transfers usually arrive within minutes.

lost-card.md
## What should I do if I lose my card?
Freeze the card immediately in the Merlion Bank app, then call our 24-hour hotline on 1800-000-0000 to report it.

lost-card.md
## Am I liable for unauthorised transactions?
Report the loss as soon as possible. Once you have reported it, you are not liable for further unauthorised transactions.

mobile-app.md
## Which phones are supported?
The app supports iOS 16 and later, and Android 10 and later.

mobile-app.md
## How do I log in?
Log in with your username and password, or set up fingerprint or face login after your first login.

mobile-app.md
## What can I do in the app?
You can check balances, transfer money, freeze cards, change limits and download e-statements.

online-security.md
## Will Merlion Bank ever ask for my one-time password?
No. Merlion Bank will never ask for your one-time password (OTP), PIN or password by phone, SMS or email.

online-security.md
## What should I do if I shared my OTP?
Call our 24-hour hotline on 1800-000-0000 immediately and freeze your accounts in the app.

opening-an-account.md
## Who can open an account?
Anyone aged 16 or above with a valid identity document can open an account.

opening-an-account.md
## How long does it take?
Opening an account online usually takes about 10 minutes.

opening-an-account.md
## What documents do I need?
You need your identity document and proof of address dated within the last 3 months.

overseas-transfers.md
## How much does an overseas transfer cost?
Each overseas telegraphic transfer costs S$10, plus any fees charged by the receiving bank.

overseas-transfers.md
## How long does an overseas transfer take?
Overseas transfers usually take 1 to 3 working days.

overseas-transfers.md
## Is there a cut-off time?
Transfers submitted after 4pm on a working day are processed on the next working day.

personal-loans.md
## What is the interest rate on a personal loan?
Effective interest rates start from 6.5% p.a. Your actual rate depends on your credit profile.

personal-loans.md
## What tenures are available?
You can choose a tenure of 1 to 5 years.

personal-loans.md
## Is there a processing fee?
A processing fee of 1% of the loan amount is deducted when the loan is disbursed.

savings-account.md
## What interest does the Everyday Savings Account pay?
The base interest rate is 0.05% p.a. on your whole balance.

savings-account.md
## How do I earn bonus interest?
Credit a salary of at least S$2,000 a month and you earn bonus interest of up to 2.10% p.a. on the first S$75,000 of your balance. Bonus interest is credited on the first business day of the following month.

savings-account.md
## Is there a minimum balance?
There is no minimum balance and no fall-below fee for the Everyday Savings Account.

scams.md
## What is the emergency freeze?
The emergency freeze locks all your accounts and cards at once. Use it in the app or call 1800-000-0000 if you think you have been scammed.

scams.md
## How do I unfreeze my accounts?
Visit any branch with your identity document to unfreeze your accounts. For your safety, accounts cannot be unfrozen online.
